url.hint: The address the sidebar's MCP section shows, without /mcp: http://192.168.1.20:51550 (http://127.0.0.1:51550 when the program runs on the same PC)

key.hint: A key from the sidebar's MCP section (vdc_...), with the jobs or the admin role. Empty works only on the server PC itself while 'This computer needs no key' is on.

upload_pictures.description: Upload the pictures people post before the model answers
upload_pictures.hint: Every picture in a message that goes to the model is uploaded to the server first, and the model is told the upload id, so it can call vdc_submit with it. The model cannot pass picture bytes to a tool by itself.

post_results.description: Post finished results into the chat by itself
post_results.hint: Jobs made from those uploads are watched, and their results are posted into the chat they came from as soon as they are done, without the model having to relay a picture.

auto_submit.description: Queue every uploaded picture at once
auto_submit.hint: Off: the model decides and calls vdc_submit (the server must be in AstrBot's MCP servers). On: the plugin queues the picture itself with the preset below, so no MCP setup and no tool call are needed; the model only relays the queue message.

preset.description: Preset for /vdc and for queued pictures
preset.hint: The name of a preset saved in the program, or default for its default look

result_text.hint: Posted before the picture; empty posts the picture alone

poll_seconds.description: Seconds between two looks at the queue
poll_seconds.hint: How often the plugin asks the server whether a watched job has finished

max_upload_mb.hint: Larger pictures and videos are left alone

timeout_seconds.hint: For one upload or download; a large video may need more
